name: asis-b154
headline: Human Written
windows: Many ferments help to different degrees, including kombucha, kimchi, and apple vinegar. I prefer fermented beet juice made with apple vinegar and salt. Smelling the ferment helps a lot. name: asis-b158-b155
headline: Mostly Human Written
windows: Most sober people don't feel much from zeolite.
Its effect becomes more obvious when a trip has a toxic or gut-driven component.
I put a spoonful into water--some people need a teaspoon, others a tablespoon--and sip slowly. Rubbing it on the body or simply holding the jar also helps me.
In my experiments, zeolite has to be prepared correctly. I use powdered zeolite rather than nano-liquid zeolite.
Many products did nothing for me, and quality mattered enormously. Most zeolites have clogged pores because they haven't been cleaned.

name: asis-b156-b157
headline: AI Detected
windows: For my ozonated zeolite, I mix the powder into water and use an ozone-water purifier in a glass vessel because ozone destroys plastic. I mean ozonating water, never inhaling ozone gas.
With a machine producing about two grams of ozone per hour, ten minutes produced a working zeolite for me.

Less time did not work as well, and more time did not noticeably improve it.
I also keep zeolite away from metal during preparation.
Zeolite adsorbs metals, which is part of why it is used for heavy-metal removal, and I don't want it sitting against a metal vessel or utensil before ingestion.
I use glass for ozonation and storage whenever possible.
